decisions.reason: The citrus harvesting crate is a flagship product for a clear agricultural niche, and reusable harvest crates have long life cycles, so withdrawal is unlikely.
Foldable large containers are a core category in returnable transport packaging, serving automotive and industrial customers, and fit the firm's sustainability direction.
Stackable crates are a low-cost staple for food, retail and pooling customers, so there is little reason to remove them.
Spill-retention pallets are a niche outside the core logistics focus, but the multi-model line still serves industrial safety needs, so keeping it remains the more likely choice.
As a single specialized pallet variant it carries the highest risk after the medium-duty pallet was withdrawn, but there is no evidence of failure, so it is likely kept for now.
